meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Ultra-compressed commit message generator. Cuts noise from commit messages while preserving intent and reasoning. Conventional Commits format. Subject ≤50 chars, body only when "why" isn't obvious. Use when user says "write a commit", "commit message", "generate commit", "/commit", or invokes /caveman-commit. Auto-triggers when staging changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把暂存变更压缩成简洁的提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次写提交信息都要纠结很久
copy.tagline_en: Compress staged changes into concise commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle to write clear commit messages

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把你的改动压缩成一条极简的提交信息,遵循 Conventional Commits 格式,主题行控制在 50 字符内,只在必要时加正文解释原因。它只生成文字,不会真的执行提交。
howto.when: 当你说 "write a commit"、"commit message"、"generate commit" 等,或调用 /caveman-commit 时;把改动加入暂存区也会自动触发。

say.note: 为暂存区改动生成极简提交信息
直接调用技能生成提交信息
恢复常规提交信息风格

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude compresses your changes into a terse commit message using Conventional Commits format, keeping the subject within 50 chars and adding a body only when necessary. It only outputs text; it never runs git commit.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "write a commit", "commit message", "generate commit", etc., or invoke /caveman-commit. Also auto-triggers when changes are staged.

say_en.note: Generates a terse commit message for staged changes.
